academic_distress_questionnaire.text: I feel anxious or frustrated when asked to read out loud in front of others.
I need extra time to complete writing tasks compared to my peers.
I feel overwhelmed when faced with complex multi-step math problems.
I feel my handwriting or writing speed holds me back despite knowing the answers.
I avoid reading long passages or books unless absolutely required.
I make careless errors in calculation even when I understand the concept.
I experience physical fatigue or tension during timed exams.
I struggle to organize my thoughts on paper during essay writing.
I worry that my academic speed does not reflect my true intelligence.
I pretend to understand reading material to avoid asking for help.
